svg.desc: Architecture diagram. Includes original Azure-Design icons under GPLv3; accompanying assets, LICENSE and provenance identify their sources. Authored with local MCP and exported locally.

g.text: ARO x86 virtualization lab: guest VMs with real, routable IPs (no NAT)
OpenShift Virtualization guests on ARO workers are reached at their own 10.101.0.x addresses. Dashed blue: BGP and learned routes (control plane only). Solid purple: packets.
Cluster VMs and NICs live in the ARO-managed resource group arovirt-rg-managed
SSH from MY_IP; 5201 and ICMP from guests
Effective route, learned from Route Server
Worker NIC IP forwarding in the managed
resource group is outside normal ARO support.
Guests have no internet egress once advertised.
Guest MTU 1400: OVN still uses Geneve.
Control plane only: learns 10.101.0.0/24, programs it into the client VNet
Primary Layer2 user-defined network across the workers, persistent IPAM
Advertised by RouteAdvertisements, which turns off OVN egress SNAT
3 x Standard_D8s_v5 masters, public API and ingress. Not on the guest data path.
